title: Prompt Stability Matters: Evaluating and Optimizing Auto-Generated Prompt in General-Purpose Systems
abstract: arXiv:2505.13546v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Automatic prompt generation plays a crucial role in enabling general-purpose multi-agent systems to perform diverse tasks autonomously. Existing methods typically evaluate prompts based on their immediate task performance, overlooking the intrinsic qualities that determine their reliability. This outcome-centric view not only limits interpretability but also fails to account for the inherent stochasticity of large language models (LLMs). In this work, we bring attention to prompt stability-the consistency of model responses across repeated executions-as a key factor for building robust and effective prompt generation systems. To quantify this, we propose semantic stability as a criterion for assessing the response consistency of prompts. translated_title: 提示稳定性至关重要：评估与优化通用系统中自动生成的提示
translated_abstract: 自动提示生成在使通用多智能体系统能够自主执行多样化任务方面发挥着关键作用。现有方法通常基于提示的即时任务表现来评估提示，而忽略了决定其可靠性的内在品质。这种以结果为中心的视角不仅限制了可解释性，而且未能考虑到大型语言模型（LLM）固有的随机性。在这项工作中，我们强调提示稳定性——即模型在重复执行中响应的一致性——作为构建鲁棒且有效的提示生成系统的关键因素。为了量化这一概念，我们提出语义稳定性作为评估提示响应一致性的标准。基于所提出的指标，我们开发了首个稳定性感知的通用提示生成系统，该系统利用稳定性反馈来迭代提升提示质量和系统性能。
tldr: 该论文提出语义稳定性这一新指标来衡量提示在重复执行时响应的一致性，并据此开发了首个利用稳定性反馈迭代优化提示质量的通用提示生成系统。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes semantic stability as a metric to measure the consistency of prompt responses across repeated executions, and develops the first stability-aware general-purpose prompt generation system that leverages stability feedback to iteratively enhance prompt quality.
